method: Reviewed both native 1254-square outputs and each 256-pixel native seam strip for A and B; reviewed combined full object and four union perimeter crops. Combined wide display overview is rescaled by viewer; individual A/B seam strips provide native detail coverage.

findings.A: Single continuous front lower brace joins both fixed posts. Duplicated upper fragment removed. Existing lower brace arriving from left preserved.
findings.B: Top rail step removed and lower brace reaches fixed right post. Extra short stump removed. Corner post alignment maintained.
findings.outerSeams: No new silhouette discontinuity or gaps observed on A left/top/bottom and B left/right/top/bottom. Timber, fish and stone outlines align across reinserted edges.
findings.minorDifferences: Small woodgrain and stone surface color variations remain across generated versus untouched pixels; no smoothing or blending used.
